reviews.author: Merissa Tilley
reviews.text: I was working my PT job with Amazon flex tonight, I got stuck in someone’s driveway tonight and they helped me out of a very ICEY situation. The Anytime Towing team risked their vehicles to get me out. I am so thankful for their help and super kind generosity.

reviews.author: Vernell Jackson
reviews.text: I was fortunate, unfortunate to have a run in this morning with Anytime Towing. My bro was in town and double parked outside my loft and was due to be towed. I heard the commotion and came out right before lift off. As I reasoned with this gentleman, he was kind enough and understanding and did not tow my bro’s car. Anytime towing will be my tow company anytime I’m in need. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Ansley Novak
reviews.text: I was attending the Cheerwine festival, like many others, and my car was towed by Anytime Towing. Not only was it a 25+ minute walk from the festival; along the way I saw families with young kids, older folks having to walk in 80+ degree weather. That is not okay, morally and as a company this should not be tolerated. Secondly, we were lied to in person about damages to our vehicle. All of this chaos, to attend a free event for a soda. I understand everyone has their own right to make a living, but this was not okay. I am now out $400 at the expense of other peoples greed. The town of Salisbury, AutoZone, and Anytime Towing should be held accountable.
